title: Limited visual presentation of text (AAA)
user_impact: Users with visual impairments or dyslexia have difficulty reading.
technical_impact: Insufficient CSS styling for line spacing or justified-text formatting.

checks.source: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.8 Visual Presentation (Level AAA), bullet 3: text is not justified
checks.applicability: Blocks of text: paragraphs with text content that are rendered.
checks.expectation:
One page-level review when at least one rendered paragraph is set with
text-align: justify, however the author set it: in a stylesheet rule, in the
style attribute, or in a media query that applies in an audited viewport.
Headings, captions and other short labels are not blocks of text. A hidden
paragraph is not presented and does not count. Review, not a violation:
1.4.8 asks for a mechanism, which a user stylesheet may provide.
